summary: A 1922 fire camp and 1925 cupola on Illahee Rock, with a live-in tower from the 1950s; sources disagree on tower dates, height and staffing.

facts.design: Live-in L-4 cab with catwalk on a 20-foot treated timber tower, beside a 1925 D-6 cupola

visit.trail_note: About 0.9 miles and 550 feet of climbing; the trail begins on a steep, rocky road that is too rough to drive

events.note: Fire camp established with the site, per firelookout.com. The register dates the older cupola to 1922 instead.

20-foot tower with live-in cab and catwalk, per the register. firelookout.com gives 1956 and Eugene Weekly gives 1958 for the tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com reads 1922 as the camp and 1925 as the D-6 cupola, and Eugene Weekly agrees on 1925. The register's 1922 date for the cupola is not explained by these sources.

notes_for_editor: Tower date: 1955 (register), 1956 (firelookout.com), 1958 (Eugene Weekly). Height: 20 feet (register and firelookout.com) versus 30 feet (Eugene Weekly). Staffing: 'still staffed each year' (register, undated) versus 'available for emergencies' (firelookout.com, undated); not resolved. Rental status not found. The Library of Congress HABS record OR-197 (loc.gov/item/or0638) returned HTTP 403 and was not read, so it is not cited; a search summary of it gave a 1956 tower and a 1920 firefinder, which should be checked. Eugene Weekly mentions a locked trap door on the 1958 tower; the story does not encourage climbing it. Height and tower date were left out of facts for these reasons.
